WAYREST - A LIGHT IN THE FOREST
Beyond the walls, Allium is dangerous. Wayrest offers a place to gather supplies, learn the crafts and prepare for the road. Visit the steward before venturing farther into the forest.

The Queen's incursions threaten even the walls of a refuge. Prepare before nightfall: repair your gear, stock food and remedies, and leave yourself a way to retreat. A strong party brings more than weapons.
